newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey to tender to sell at least 200,000 T barley.
newsitem.headline: Turkey to tender to sell at least 200,000 T barley.

text.p: Turkey will hold a tender on Thursday to export at least 200,000 tonnes of barley for October-December delivery, a grain official said.
"The exact amount is not clear yet. But it is not less than 200,000 tonnes," said the official.
He said the Turkish Grain Board (TMO) would tender for feed barley but added some malt barley exports could also be considered in the tender.
The TMO has bought more than 600,000 tonnes of barley from farmers this year and officials earlier said it planned to export up to 300,000 tonnes.
Turkey this year expects total barley output of eight million tonnes, up from seven million in 1995/96.
